MINISTRY OF CULTURE 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 27th August, 2026 
G.S.R. 159.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Anthropological Survey of India (Hindi Translator) Recruitment Rules, 1989, except as respects 
things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating 


the method of recruitment to the post of Junior Translation Officer in the Anthropological Survey of India, Ministry 
of Culture, namely: - 


1. Short title and commencement.— (1) These rules may be called the Ministry of Culture, 
Anthropological Survey of India, Junior Translation Officer (Group ‘B’ Post) Recruitment Rules, 2026. 
(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. Number of post, classification and level in pay matrix.— The number of the said post, its classification and 


level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to 
these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc— The method of recruitment, age-limit, 
qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the 
said Schedule. 

4. Disqualification.— No person, - 


(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the 
personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds 
for so doing, exempt any person from the operation of this rule.

शक्तियाँ प्रदान करने का आवेदन करना चाहता है, जो टेलीग्राफ प्राधिकरण सरकार द्वारा स्थापित या अनुरक्षित या इस प्रकार स्थापित या 
अनुरक्षित किए जाने वाले टेलीग्राफ के प्रयोजन से टेलीग्राफ लाइनें बिछाने और खंभों को लगाने के संबंध में भारतीय टेलीग्राफ अधिनियम 
1885 के अंतर्गत रखता है और सर्वेक्षण, निर्माण, संस्थापन, निरीक्षण, निर्माण और अन्य कार्य आरंभ करेगा जिसके बाद निम्नांकित पारेषण 
योजना के लिए कमीशनिंग, परिचालन, रखरखाव और अन्य कार्य किए जाएँगे: 


ट्रांसमिशन योजना का नाम - मे. Req समीर शक्ति प्राइवेट लिमिटेड को बाड़मेर, राजस्थान में अपने 200 मेगावॉट सोलर प्रोजेक्ट के लिए 
कनेक्टिविटी प्रदान करने के लिए ट्रांसमिशन सिस्टम में समाहित डेडिकेटेड ओवरहेड ट्रांसमिशन को संस्थापित करना.

कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार

अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय कम्पनी

2. इसके द्वारा यह सूचित किया जाता है कि कम्पनी अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 248 (2) के तहत कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार को उपर्युक्त 
कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार 
आरंभ करने में विफल रहे हैं या इस आधार पर कि कम्पनी पूर्ववर्ती 2 वित्तीय वर्षों से कारोबार नहीं कर पाई है और इस अवधि के भीतर कम्पनी 
अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय कम्पनी 
की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने का अनुरोध 
किया है। 


3. तदनुसार, कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार उपर्युक्त कम्पनियों के नामों को कम्पनियों के रजिस्टर से हटाने का प्रस्ताव करता है। 


4. यदि किसी व्यक्ति/संस्था को कम्पनी को कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से कम्पनियों का नाम हटाने के प्रस्ताव से आपत्ति है तो वह व्यक्ति/संस्था 
इस सूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से 30 (तीस) दिनों के भीतर उपर्युक्त कार्यालय के पते पर अपनी आपत्ति भेज सकते हैं ।

अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय कम्पनी

आ.अ. 407.--यतः, भारत निर्वाचन आयोग द्वारा दिनांक 29 अप्रैल, 2024 की अधिसूचना 
सं0464/ईपीएस/2024(6) के अनुसरण में ओड़िशा राज्य की लोक सभा के लिए साधारण निर्वाचन 2024 आयोजित 
किया गया था; और 


यतः लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम, 4954 की धारा 78 के अनुसार, किसी निर्वाचन मे, निर्वाचन लड़ रहा प्रत्येक 
अभ्यर्थी, निर्वाचित अभ्यर्थी के निर्वाचन की तारीख से 30 दिनों के भीतर निर्वाचन व्यय का लेखा जिला निर्वाचन 
अधिकारी के पास दाखिल करेगा जो उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 77 के अंतर्गत उसके द्वारा या उसके निर्वाचन अभिकर्ता 
(एजेंट) द्वारा रखे गए लेखे की एक सत्य प्रति होगी; और

अन्तिम तारीख 4 जुलाई, 2024 थी; और 


यतः, निर्वाचनों का संचालन नियम, (96 के नियम 89 के उप-नियम (॥) अंतर्गत, जिला निर्वाचन अधिकारी, 
सम्बलपुर की रिपोर्ट दिनांक शून्य जो मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी, ओड़िशा से दिनांक 34.07.2024 पत्र FO EC-CON- 
0058-0403-2024-2756 (Elec.) को प्राप्त हुई थी, के अनुसार श्री श्रीराम पांडे जो ओड़िशा राज्य के 03-सम्बलपुर

ELECTION COMMISSION OF INDIA 
ORDER 
New Delhi, the !2th February, 2026 


O.N. 07.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Lok Sabha of Odisha, 2024 was held in pursuance of the 
Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/EPS/2024/(6) dated 29" April, 2024. And 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 95, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent 
under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned elections for 03-Sambalpur Parliamentary Constituency of 
Odisha was declared by the Returning Officer on 4 June, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of 
Election Expenses was 47 July, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the District Election Officer, Sambalpur, Odisha report dated NIL forwarded by the 
Chief Electoral Officer, Odisha vide their EC-CON-COE-003-2024-2756 (Elec.) dated 3“ July, 2024, under sub- 
tule () of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 96, Sh. Sriram Pandey, a contesting candidate from 03- 
Sambalpur Parliamentary Constituency of Odisha has failed to lodge his account of election expenses, as required 
under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Sambalpur , a Show-Cause notice 
No. 76/ODISHA/PC-03/2024/CEMS-IV, dated 04..2024 was issued under sub-rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 96l by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Sriram Pandey, for not lodging of his account 
of Election Expenses; and, 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub-rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, [96], Sh. Sriram Pandey, was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Sambalpur within 20 days from the date of receipt of the Notice; and 


Whereas, District Election Officer, Sambalpur vide his letter no. 2990/Elec dated 7.02.2025 informed that 
the said notice was served to his son on 24.0.2025, and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Sambalpur in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. 
2990/Elec. dated 7.02.2025 has reported that Sh. Sriram Pandey, has not submitted his account of election 
expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Sriram Pandey, has neither furnished any reason nor 
explanation to the Commission of India, for failure to lodged the account as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section |0 A of the Representation of the People Act, 95 provides that :- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the 
Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of 
three years from the date of the order.” 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Sriram Pandey has 
failed to lodge his account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section l0A of the Representation of the People Act, 95, the Election 
Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Sriram Pandey resident of At- Junush Patna, PO- College Square, PS- 
Mal Godown, Dist- Cuttack, a contesting candidate from 03-Sambalpur Parliamentary Constituency of General 
Election to the Lok Sabha of Odisha , 2024, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either 
House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a 
period of three years from the date of this order.

New Delhi, the 24th August, 2026 


G.S.R. 60.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Department of Economic Affairs, Staff Car Driver Group ‘C’, Recruitment Rule, 989, except as 
respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules 
regulating the method of recruitment to the posts of Staff Car Driver Grade (Ordinary Grade), Staff Car Driver 
Grade IJ and Staff Car Driver Grade I, in the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, namely: 


. Short title and commencement. — (l) These rules may be called the Ministry of Finance, Department of 
Economic Affairs, Staff Car Driver Grade (Ordinary Grade), Staff Car Driver Grade II and Staff Car Driver Grade I, 
Recruitment Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the official Gazette. 


2. Application. — These rules shall apply to the posts as specified in column (l) of the Schedule annexed to 
these rules. 


3. Number of posts, classification, level in pay matrix. — The number of the said posts, their classification, 
level in the pay matrix attached thereto, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the said Schedule. 


4. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualification, etc. - The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications 
and other matters relating to the said posts shall be as specified in columns (5) to ((3) of the said Schedule. 


a Disqualifications. — No person, — 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said posts: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule. 


6. Power to relax. — Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, 
it may, by order, for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any 
class or category of persons. 


Vs Saving. — Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions 
required to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, other backward classes, ex-servicemen and 
other special categories of persons, in accordance with the orders issued by Central Government from time to time in 
this regard.

New Delhi, the 3rd September 2026 


No. 9-/2026-U.3(A): Whereas, the Central Government is empowered under Section 3 of the University Grants 
Commission (UGC) Act, 956 to declare, on the advice of the UGC, an Institution of higher learning as an Institution deemed 
to be University. 


2. And whereas, an online application dated 5.05.2025 was submitted by the Sau. Mathurabai Bhausaheb Thorat 
Sevabhavi Trust (SMBT Sevabhavi Trust) on the UGC’s Portal for grant of Institution deemed to be University status under 
distinct category in the name of SMBT, SMBT Educational Campus, Nandi Hills, Dhamangaon-Ghoti, Nashik, Maharashtra 
consisting of the following institutions: 


i. SMBT College of Pharmacy; 
il. SMBT Ayurveda College & Hospital; 
iil. SMBT Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre; 
Iv. SMBT Institute of Dental Sciences & Research; 
v. SMBT Institute of Nursing; and 
Vi. SMBT College of Physiotherapy. 


3. And whereas, Ministry of Education, on the advice of UGC, issued Letter of Intent (Lol) dated 06.03.2026 to SMBT 
Sevabhavi Trust for fulfilment of certain conditions within a period of three years before conferment of Institution deemed to 
be University status under distinct category in the name of SMBT, Nashik, Maharashtra. 


4. And further whereas, the Managing Trustee, SMBT Sevabhavi Trust, vide letter dated 09.04.2026, submitted 
compliance report in respect of the conditions mentioned in the Lol, which was then forwarded to UGC for verification and 
advice. Further, UGC informed that the compliance report was accepted by its Expert Committee. The recommendation of 
UGC Expert Committee was considered and approved by the Commission in its 598 meeting (Item No. 2.5) held on 
06.07.2026. 


5. Now, therefore, in exercise of powers conferred under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 956, the Ministry of Education, on 
the advice of the UGC, hereby declares SMBT, Nandi Hills, Dhamangaon-Ghoti, Nashik, Maharashtra as an Institution deemed 
to be University under distinct category consisting of the institutions mentioned in para 2 above. The said declaration is subject 
to the following conditions: 


i. All the undertakings given by the sponsoring body shall be strictly followed by the deemed to be University. 


il. There shall be no diversion of assets or funds/revenues of the Institution deemed to be University/or of its constituent 
teaching units, without prior permission of the UGC and Ministry of Education. 
ili. All other Institutions (except as mentioned in para 2 of the Notification) running under SMBT Sevabhavi Trust shall 


not be included under the purview of SMBT (Deemed to be University), Nashik, Maharashtra without previous 
approval of the Ministry. 

iv. The academic programmes to be offered at SMBT, Nashik, Maharashtra shall conform to the norms and standards 
prescribed by the UGC and the Statutory Councils/Bodies concerned. 

v. SMBT, Nashik, Maharashtra shall align its courses with National Education Policy-2020. 

Vi. All the prescribed norms and procedures of the Statutory Councils concerned in the matter of admission of students, 
intake capacity of students, renewal of approval to the academic course / programme, revision of intake capacity of 
students, starting of new courses / programmes, etc. shall continue to be in force, and shall be adhered to by SMBT, 
Nashik, Maharashtra. 

Vil. SMBT, Nashik, Maharashtra shall submit MoA in accordance with UGC (Institutions Deemed to be Universities) 

Regulations, 2023 to this Ministry and UGC. Further, as and when necessary, it shall update or revise or modify its 

MoA / Rules, as per the provisions of the prevailing Regulations. 

Viil. SMBT, Nashik, Maharashtra shall follow the fee structure as per the Rules and Regulations of the UGC and relevant 

Statutory Councils. 

Ix. SMBT, Nashik, Maharashtra shall participate in annual Indian rankings issued by National Institutional Ranking 

Framework (NIRF) of this Ministry. 

xX SMBT, Nashik, Maharashtra shall compulsorily create Academic Bank of Credits (ABC), identities of their students 
and upload their credit score in digital lockers and ensure that the credit scores are reflected in ABC Portal and adopt 
Samarth e-Gov. 


K.M. PRAPHULLACHANDRA SHARMA, Joint Secretary

G.S.R. 6l.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Soil and Land Use Survey of India (Soil Survey Officer) Recruitment Rules, 20I3, except as 
respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules 
regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Soil Survey Officer in the Soil and Land Use Survey of India 
under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, namely: — 


l. Short title and commencement. — (l) These rules may be called the Ministry of Agriculture and 
Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Soil and Land Use Survey of India, Soil Survey 
Officer (Group -‘A’ post) Recruitment Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of posts, classification and level in pay matrix. — The number of the said posts, its 
classification and level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule 
annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit and other qualifications, etc. — The method of recruitment, age- 
limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (3) of the said 
Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. — No person, — 

(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. — Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so 
to do, it may, by order for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the Union Public Service 
Commission, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. — Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions 
required to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Class, ex-servicemen or 
other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time 
in this regard.
